objectives.can_do: I can give a relevant 60-90 second professional introduction.
I can identify which experience is relevant to a target role.

chunks: One result I'm proud of is ...
I'm interested in this role because ...

choice_points.prompt: Choose the role and interviewer perspective for your answer.

learner_agency.competence_signal: I can give a relevant professional introduction and handle a follow-up without notes.
learner_agency.reflection_prompt: Which evidence made your answer more credible?

activities.instruction_en: Listen and order the introduction: present role, evidence, target role.
activities.instruction_th: ฟังแล้วเรียงส่วนของคำตอบ: งานปัจจุบัน ผลงาน และงานเป้าหมาย

content.audio_transcript: I currently work as a site engineer. I coordinate subcontractors and check progress against drawings. One result I'm proud of is reducing rework on my last project. I'm now looking for a role where I can take more responsibility for project delivery.

activities.instruction_en: Choose the introduction that is more relevant to a project-engineer interview and explain why.
activities.instruction_th: เลือกคำตอบที่เกี่ยวข้องกับตำแหน่งวิศวกรโครงการมากกว่าและอธิบายเหตุผล

options: I enjoy many hobbies and I studied engineering.
I coordinate site work and recently reduced drawing-related rework by improving the checking process.

activities.instruction_en: Write three notes: your current value, one piece of evidence, and why the target role fits.
activities.instruction_th: เขียนโน้ตสามส่วน: คุณค่าปัจจุบัน หลักฐานหนึ่งเรื่อง และเหตุผลที่เหมาะกับตำแหน่ง

activities.instruction_en: Answer 'Tell me about yourself' in 60-90 seconds using your notes.
activities.instruction_th: ตอบคำถาม Tell me about yourself ภายใน 60-90 วินาทีโดยใช้โน้ต

activities.instruction_en: Answer the interviewer's follow-up questions without reading your original answer.
activities.instruction_th: ตอบคำถามต่อเนื่องของผู้สัมภาษณ์โดยไม่อ่านคำตอบเดิม

activities.instruction_en: Use your notes and feedback to write a concise version for the hiring manager.
activities.instruction_th: ใช้โน้ตและ feedback สรุปคำตอบที่กระชับสำหรับ hiring manager

content.source: The learner's outline, first answer, and approved feedback from this lesson.
content.audience: hiring manager for the selected role

activities.instruction_en: Give one final 60-90 second answer without notes.
activities.instruction_th: ตอบรอบสุดท้าย 60-90 วินาทีโดยไม่ใช้โน้ต

criteria.description: The answer addresses the target role and avoids unrelated biography.
The answer supports value with a specific responsibility or result.
The answer has a clear present-evidence-future structure.
Grammar and vocabulary communicate the intended meaning accurately enough.
Speech is intelligible and sufficiently fluent for an interview.

allowed: suggest a clearer answer preserving facts
forbidden: reward grammar when the answer is irrelevant
ai_policy.fallback: Use three fixed follow-up questions and save the recording for later rubric scoring.

accessibility.non_audio_alternative: Allow typed interview responses and provide transcripts for every model answer.
